column1: # The closed list of values of code of the Problem answer of the backend doors: chapters 11.1–11.6, 11.8, 11.20 (ADR-0094 B5; measurement С.5). Moved from Н4, it does not change the norms: on a mismatch the source is the norm in the column norm.

# The word error here is the code of the contract. Where it is translated from (a console or domain word) — in the column norm. The values — the list ProblemCode of the contract; there are no own codes (V/11.2 Н1.3).

# door — the contract doors: units — `/kinds`, `/units` and the subject paths `/units/{uid}/…` (the folders are records of the kind `folder`); objects; domains — `/domains/{domainId}/…`; operations; discovery; access; rules; schedules — and day-groups, modes, maintenance-windows; exports — and /me/export (11.20); test — /test/*; * — every door. code — the status; 4xx — the door status; «-» — the code of a step result, a failed group record has no status: 200.

# field — «-»: there is no field; <поле> — the contract field that the refusal names; otherwise — the exact value: on the core paths a JSON Pointer (/name, /parentId, /kind, /folders, /properties/<имя>; V/11.14 Н1.2), outside them and in the parameters of a request — the name of the schema field. 502–504 — UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE (V/11.2 Н1.3). The words of the assistant turn — V/11.7.
